jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

Super is growing across existing and new markets, investing in technology and pursuing growth through both organic development and M&A. As Financial Controller, you will join the Group Finance team responsible for consolidated statutory and management reporting, owning assigned consolidation and reporting workstreams and supporting divisional finance teams in applying Group policies. This is a hands-on role for a qualified accountant who will help resolve accounting and control issues across our multi-entity international business.

What you'll be doing:

Group reporting and consolidation

- Own assigned monthly and year-end consolidation workstreams and maintain balance sheet discipline through reconciliations, substantiation and timely resolution of aged items.

- Prepare and review consolidation files and adjustments, and produce monthly financial reporting and analysis explaining material movements to stakeholders.

Technical accounting and financial control

- Apply IFRS and Group accounting policies to complex or judgemental transactions, preparing audit-ready technical accounting papers and supporting accounting for business combinations, share-based payments, impairments, provisions and leases.

- Guide divisional teams on applying Group policies consistently and strengthen controls around manual journals and reporting adjustments.

Audit and financial statements

- Support the interim and year-end external audit, coordinating requests, preparing evidence and resolving auditor queries.

- Prepare accounting papers, financial statement working papers and note disclosures, and review year-end processes to resolve control matters before sign-off.

Process improvement and collaboration

- Review and improve consolidation processes and controls, and support development of D365, Anaplan EPM and related reporting tools.

- Partner with Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Legal, Technology, Internal Audit and regional finance teams on Group-level analysis.

What we are looking for:

- Professional qualification – ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent, supported by strong academic credentials and degree-level education.

- Typically three to four years of post-qualified experience, ideally combining Big Four or other leading audit-firm training with an in-house Group Finance, reporting or controllership role.

- Practical experience of group consolidations, monthly close, financial controls and statutory or management reporting in a complex multi-entity organisation.

- Strong IFRS knowledge and the ability to reach clear, commercially practical conclusions on complex or judgemental accounting matters.

- Experience working independently within a multicultural, multi-location organisation, collaborating effectively across countries and time zones.

- Strong project-management skills, attention to detail and the initiative to improve processes and provide direction to others.

- Fluent English, excellent written communication and the ability to build trusted relationships with finance and non-finance stakeholders.

- Strong Excel capability and experience with ERP, consolidation or performance-management systems.

Nice to have:

- Experience with D365 and Anaplan EPM.

- Experience in gaming, digital, technology, retail, e-commerce or another fast-growing international business.

What we offer

- Medical / Health Insurance

- Open Annual Leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.
About Super

We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

Shaping the Future of Play

Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page:  super.xyz/careers

Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA).

At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance.

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

As an  Operations Lead , you play a key role in keeping our Core Operations running smoothly while continuously improving how we work. In this role, you are the driving force behind our day-to-day operational performance, ensuring that our most important customer journeys and operational processes run in a stable, efficient and predictable way.

You work closely with various internal teams and external partners to build a strong operational structure around areas such as payments, onboarding & access, KYC processes, incident management, vendor governance and operational projects .

With your structured approach and strong sense of ownership, you ensure that processes do not depend on individual people, but instead run through a clear cadence, measurable KPIs and consistent follow-up on actions.

Your Responsibilities:

- Monitor and optimise the daily performance of our payment flows (both deposits and withdrawals), actively working to reduce failures and recurring issues.

- Manage escalations with payment providers and other external partners, ensuring clear follow-up, well-defined SLAs and structural improvements.

- Coordinate the full incident management process , from triage and communication to follow-up and post-incident reviews, ensuring actions are effectively completed.

- Analyse operational data and translate insights into concrete improvement initiatives that contribute to more stable and efficient customer journeys.

- Optimise processes around onboarding, login/access and KYC processing , with a focus on SLA adherence, throughput and reducing customer friction.

- Work closely with Product, Tech, Compliance and other stakeholders to implement operational improvements and ensure smooth operational launches of new processes or changes.

- Manage relationships with external partners and vendors, monitor their performance and maintain clear escalation and follow-up processes.

- Lead operational projects and implementations, ensuring clear scope, priorities and consistent follow-up on progress and action items.

- Organise and lead weekly operations reviews , where KPIs, incidents, escalations and improvement initiatives are tracked and discussed.

- Maintain clear documentation, processes and runbooks to ensure the team can work efficiently and in a structured way.

- Coach and support the Operations Specialist , contributing to a culture of ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement within the operations team.

Your Winning Profile:

- At least 3 years of experience in operations within a high-transaction or regulated environment (e.g. iGaming, fintech, payments or e-commerce).

- Experience with payment operations and PSP ecosystems .

- Experience with incident management and root cause analysis .

- Strong analytical skills and experience working with operational KPIs and performance metrics .

- Experience managing projects, priorities and operational improvement initiatives .

- Strong stakeholder management skills and experience collaborating with Tech, Product, Compliance and external partners .

- A proactive mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work in a structured way within a dynamic environment.

Nice to haves

- Experience with KYC processes and compliance requirements .

- Familiarity with tools such as Zendesk or similar service platforms .

- Interest in or experience with operational data and automation .

- Experience in an environment where Operations works closely with Customer Service or VIP teams .

Our Offer

In return for your dedication and expertise, we offer a challenging career in a unique and dynamic environment. You will receive an attractive salary package with various extra-legal benefits such as a company car and performance bonus, as well as ample opportunities for growth and career development. Our headquarters are located in Aalst, between Brussels and Ghent.

As part of the Superbet Group , we at Napoleon Sports & Casino are unstoppable. Our ambitious growth plans offer employees exciting opportunities to contribute to the expansion and future of our company.

jobs.title: Senior Business Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

As Senior Business Transformation Lead , you will convert complex, cross-functional business problems into scoped initiatives that are delivered, adopted, and measured — bringing PMO discipline where needed, though the primary value of the role is transformation leadership rather than project or portfolio administration. The role sits within Business Transformation as the primary execution lead for priorities that cut across functions, ownership areas, or operating models — priorities that would otherwise stall for lack of a clear owner. You will also help mature a fit-for-purpose Transformation Office, building portfolio visibility, prioritisation cadence, governance rhythm, and delivery standards.

What the role involves:

- Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and scope definition through to delivery, adoption, and benefits tracking, taking ownership where accountability does not sit clearly within one function.

- Convert ambiguous priorities into structured delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, risks, dependencies, and decisions, bringing structure without adding bureaucracy.

- Partner with the Business Architect and Head of Automation to translate target operating model, capability, and process designs into practical delivery.

- Enable process reengineering and operating model change by working with functional owners and Business/Process Specialists to simplify, standardise, and reengineer end-to-end processes as part of the initiatives you lead.

- Embed AI-enabled ways of working by partnering with the AI enablement team to identify and deliver AI-augmented process, workflow, and decision-making improvements within your initiatives.

- Manage adoption and people impact by owning resistance management, engagement, and behavioural adoption in partnership with the Change Manager and business leaders.

- Support the build-out of Transformation Office foundations, including portfolio visibility, prioritisation cadence, delivery standards, governance rhythm, and executive-level reporting.

- Act as a trusted partner to the VP, Transformation on transformation planning, governance, executive communication, and strategic priority-setting.

What we are looking for

- Significant experience leading large-scale, cross-functional business transformation — either in-house at scale or in a senior role at a management consultancy — with a proven track record of moving initiatives from design into execution, adoption, and measurable outcomes, not only strategy or design work.

- Strong experience in process reengineering and organisational design applied as a delivery activity (rather than pure architecture), including data flows.

- Experience delivering or embedding AI-enabled transformation, such as process automation, AI-augmented workflows, or AI adoption at scale.

- Strong end-to-end programme delivery skills: planning, governance, risk and dependency management, and benefits realisation.

- Ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems and translate strategic priorities into clear, sequenced plans.

- Strong stakeholder management and influence at executive level, with the ability to align competing functions and drive decisions.

- Strong change management judgement, covering adoption risk, communications, engagement, and resistance management.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level papers, decision logs, and updates.

- Commercial judgement, with the ability to focus transformation work on measurable business value.

- Comfort operating in an agile, fluid environment where priorities and ownership shift.

Nice to have

- Prior experience in tech, entertainment, media, or other high-velocity businesses.

- Experience with data-enabled or digitally-enabled transformation.

- Familiarity with vendor and partner management in a transformation context.

What we offer

- Medical / Health Insurance

- Open Annual Leave

- Employee Assistance Programme

- Training & Learning Development

Additional benefits vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day.

At Superbet, we want to elevate our brand to the next level and continue making waves in the Serbian market. Our goal is to deliver the best marketing campaigns and exceed our customers' expectations. We are looking for an experienced individual who is responsible for strengthening brand relevance, consideration and Top-of-Mind awareness, translating the company’s commercial strategy into impactful brand communication and activation.

The role owns the development and execution of the local brand strategy across ATL, digital, sponsorships, partnerships, content and on-ground activations, ensuring that brand investment contributes to both long-term brand equity and measurable commercial growth.

What you'll be doing:

- Brand Strategy & Positioning: Develop and execute the local brand strategy in line with overall business and commercial objectives. Strengthen brand positioning, differentiation and relevance within a highly competitive betting and gaming market.

- Integrated Marketing & Campaign Management: Coordinate development and execution of integrated brand campaigns across TV, OOH, digital, social, content, PR and BTL. Own the full campaign lifecycle: brief, creative development, media coordination, execution and post-campaign evaluation.

- Sponsorships and club relations: Manage communication with sports clubs, event organizers, and other partners, ensuring contractual obligations and negotiated benefits are fully delivered. Identify new partnerships and cultural/sports opportunities capable of strengthening brand relevance and differentiation.

- Planning and executing activations: Build activation strategies that go beyond visibility and generate measurable consumer engagement and commercial value. Plan and directly participate in delivering on-spot brand activations at sporting events, stadiums, fan zones, and promotional areas.

- Consumer & Competitive Insights:  Monitor brand health, consumer perception and competitive activity. Track competitor communication, sponsorships, promotional strategies and media presence.

- Budget & Performance Management:  Own and manage the allocated brand marketing budget. Define KPIs and measurement frameworks for major campaigns, sponsorships and activations. Evaluate effectiveness through brand uplift, reach, engagement, acquisition contribution and ROI/ROMI where measurable.

- Practical team and resource organization: You will coordinate with multidisciplinary creative teams,partner closely with Acquisition, CRM, Product, Casino, Sportsbook, Commercial and Operations teams. Lead external creative, media, production, PR and activation agencies. Coordinate multiple stakeholders and projects while maintaining high execution standards and speed to market. Manage agencies and external partners, ensuring quality, speed and cost efficiency.

What we are looking for:

- Minimum of 3 years of experience in advertising/digital/PR agencies or in a Brand Manager role within the consumer goods sector.

- Strong understanding of digital, social, ATL and BTL marketing.

- Experience with sports sponsorships, partnerships or entertainment marketing is highly desirable.

- Commercial mindset with the ability to connect brand activity with business performance.

- You are creative by nature, you think outside the box, propose innovative ideas, and have the ability to connect various creative resources to bring authentic sports stories to life.

- Strong organizational skills, pay attention to detail, and apply a hands-on approach to problem-solving.

- Know how to gather feedback from multiple internal and external stakeholders and seamlessly implement it into the final product.

- Are flexible and open to field work, including working weekends or outside regular hours when major events take place.

- You have a solid understanding of the local and international betting industry and a genuine passion for sports.
